lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is the San Miguel County BOCC meeting Wednesday, August 5, where commissioners hold public hearings on three Land Use Code amendments — including changes to who qualifies as an 'owner' under affordable housing rules, a wildfire overlay update, and nonconforming lots, all moving toward formal action. The Open Space Commission meets Monday to pick a preferred trail alignment for Reach 1 of the Valley Floor River Trail, with three wetland-sensitive routes still in play. Mountain Village's Design Review Board takes up three multifamily projects Thursday, and Ouray County planners meet virtually Wednesday to quietly reshape their own land-use definitions.

notable.stake: Public hearings on three Land Use Code amendments, including housing ownership rules and wildfire overlay.
Commission selects preferred Valley Floor River Trail alignment from three competing routes.
Design review and conditional-use permit decisions on three new multifamily projects in Mountain Village.
Land use definition changes that could quietly shift what county rules allow or prohibit.
